name: Tonga
label: Migrant residents (birthplace-based estimate)
basis: The UN uses birthplace here. Someone born in another country or area who moved here decades ago and became a citizen still counts. Under this rule, a child born here to parents who moved from abroad counts as locally born. The UN supplements this estimate with figures for refugees, asylum seekers and other displaced people where applicable.
coverageNote: The UN lists individually reported origins and an “Other origins” group. An unlisted origin has no separate published figure.
